#### Overcharge

General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 8+)

You gain the following benefits.

Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma
score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Stamina Drain. When you use either Spell Chucker or Destruction, you
gain one level of exhaustion for each ability used.

Spell Chucker. When you take the Magic action to cast a level 1+ spell,
you can use your Bonus Action to cast a level 1+ spell that also has a
casting time of 1 action. The spell you cast as a Bonus Action must be
at least 1 level lower than the initial spell cast. This ability ignores
the restriction on only using 1 spell slot per turn.

Destruction. When you cast a spell that deals damage, you can choose to
do maximum damage with a spell, but trigger a Wild Magic Surge and take
half the damage you deal

#### Size Doesn't Matter

General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)

You gain the following benefits.

Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Constitution score by
1, to a maximum of 20.

Powerful Build. You count as one size larger when grappling, determining
your carrying capacity, and how much you can push lift or drag

Large Size. You can cast Enlarge/Reduce on yourself without expending a
spell slot. Once you cast that spell in this way, you must complete a
long rest before using this trait again.

#### Weapon Expert

General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 8+, The ability to use the mastery
property of at least one kind of weapon)

You gain the following benefits.

Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or
Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Power Strike. Before you make a melee attack with a weapon that you can
use the mastery property for, you can choose to take a -3 penalty to the
attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +1d10 to the attack's damage.

Relentless. When you hit with a weapon that you can use the mastery
property for, you can activate the Vex or Sap mastery property in
addition to a different mastery property you’re using with that weapon.

#### Gunner (for cowboy rules only)

General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Proficiency in Firearms)

Ability Score Increase. Increase your Dexterity by 1 to a maximum of 20

Quickdraw. You ignore the Loading and Special Reload properties of
firearms.

Deadeye. As a Bonus Action, you can focus your aim until the end of your
turn. When you do so, you gain a +1d4 bonus to attack and damage rolls
with Firearms.

High Noon. You learn the Tumbleweed cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or
Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.
